codex.ssc-extras.instincts_2: You sense that indulging your instincts further could make this transformation permanent. Refraining from them lets your instincts gradually subside.
info.ssc-extras.inhibitor_calmed_instinc: Your instinct eases. Your form remains unchanged.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.cursed: Binds itself to cursed wearers. Curses an uncursed wearer.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.release: Remove at permanent form, or use an Inhibitor at original form with zero instinct.
tooltip.ssc-extras.collar.infuse: Craft with a curse potion to infuse its form.
screen.ssc-extras.effigy.tool_use: Empty hand: strip / make paths; sneak to till.
slot.ssc-extras.head: Helmet infusion
screen.ssc-extras.effigy.empty_hand: Works with an empty main hand.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ti: The earth lends you its strength.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.ap: Earthy scales emerge in patches. A stubby tail, short snout and tiny forehead horns mark the beginning of your transformation.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.pr: Raw meat, fish and potatoes provide the nutrition of their cooked versions. Other food remains edible.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.co: Helmets and leggings no longer fit.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_0.in: Eating raw food feeds your draconic instincts. Collars and matching curse potions also advance the transformation.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_0.d: Earthy scales emerge in patches. A stubby tail, short snout and tiny forehead horns mark the beginning of your transformation.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ti: The earth lends you its strength.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.ap: Your larger body stands two blocks tall. Your neck, horns, snout and tail lengthen. Three claws grow on each hand and foot.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.pr: +1 heart and 3 natural armor. Empty hands deal 3 damage and dig with stone-tool speed and harvest level. Eating is 50% faster.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.co: Helmets, leggings and boots no longer fit.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_1.in: Eating raw food feeds your draconic instincts. Collars and matching curse potions also advance the transformation.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_1.d: Your larger body stands two blocks tall. Your neck, horns, snout and tail lengthen. Three claws grow on each hand and foot.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ti: The earth lends you its strength.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.ap: Most of your body is scaled. Your thick tail balances a hunched, 2.2-block-tall stance. Your legs are digitigrade and your hands have lost their thumbs. You run on all fours and walk that way when too hungry to sprint.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.pr: +4 hearts, 15 natural armor and 50% knockback resistance. Empty claws have iron-tool harvest level and iron-sword damage (6), with all melee damage multiplied by 1.25. Eating is twice as fast. Sprinting is 20% faster.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.co: No armor fits. Tools and weapons slip out of your grip, and offhand items drop. You carry other items in your mouth. Claw digging and claw damage require an empty main hand. Restricted equipment can be infused at a Feral Effigy.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_2.in: Eating raw food feeds your draconic instincts. Collars and matching curse potions also advance the transformation.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_2.d: Most of your body is scaled. Your thick tail balances a hunched, 2.2-block-tall stance. Your legs are digitigrade and your hands have lost their thumbs. You run on all fours and walk that way when too hungry to sprint.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ti: The earth lends you its strength.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.ap: You are a wingless, fully quadrupedal earthen drake with olive-brown scales, a pale stone belly, dark horns and a heavy tail. All four digitigrade paws have pads and three thick claws. Your body is 1.6 blocks wide and 1.65 blocks high.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.pr: +6 hearts, then +10% maximum health (17.6 hearts without other bonuses). Diamond-tool claws and diamond-sword damage (7), with all melee damage multiplied by 1.5. Scales reduce incoming damage by 75%, replacing the earlier natural armor. 50% knockback resistance, twice-as-fast eating and the sprint bonus remain.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.co: This form is permanent. You only move on all fours. Armor, tools, weapons and offhand items remain restricted. Infused weapons replace innate claw damage; stronger infused tools can improve claw mining.
codex.form.ssc-extras.earthen_drake_3.in: Eating raw food feeds your draconic instincts. Collars and matching curse potions also advance the transformation.
origin.ssc-extras.form_earthen_drake_3.d: You are a wingless, fully quadrupedal earthen drake with olive-brown scales, a pale stone belly, dark horns and a heavy tail. All four digitigrade paws have pads and three thick claws. Your body is 1.6 blocks wide and 1.65 blocks high.
